does_not_do: It needs the user's own Ethereum node or provider and covers Ethereum only.
focus_reason: It fits the need on paper, but there has been no release since 2024-04-11, no GitHub workflow runs its tests, and 118 issues are open.
measured_against: Need: extract onchain transaction data into files or a database.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory and a Travis CI file; the GitHub workflows only publish to Docker Hub and PyPI.
what_it_is: Python scripts that export Ethereum blocks, transactions, token transfers, receipts and logs to CSV or relational databases.
